title: Strict Physical Multi-Host Single-Writer Partitioning
rationale: Rechner 1 (Mac) holds exclusive PRODUCT_SINGLE_WRITER role for universuX and core git commits. PC2 (Windows 10) holds MEMORY_RIGHT_ARM role for heavy compute, research, and offline engineering. No cross-host remote execution permitted.
enforcement: Hard guard: windows runtime strictly refuses Mac SSH/RDP and universuX file modifications.

title: Hierarchical NTFS Resource Locking over Simple TaskID Equality
rationale: Simple equality checks (lease.task_id === task_id) allow concurrent workers to corrupt parent and subpath directories. Normalized path prefix containment (normA.startsWith(normB + "/")) is required.

title: Pre-Dispatch Cryptographic Passport Binding
rationale: Workers must not be dispatched without a signed passport binding task_id, version, goal_id, scope_paths, and max_capability.
enforcement: BorderGuard inspects signature and scope before worker acquires lease.

title: Process Identity Bound by PID + Start Time + Token
rationale: Windows recycled PIDs cause collisions where an unrelated process inherits an active lease and gets killed or telemetry-tracked incorrectly. PID must be verified with start time epoch and task token.

title: Length-Prefixed SHA-256 Checksum Framed Append Log
rationale: Unframed append-only journals corrupt replay on power cut or hard kill. Framed format isolates torn trailing writes cleanly.

title: Worker Disallowed from Setting Global Mission Saturation
rationale: Workers reporting "all my tests passed" created self-written saturation prosecutors that prematurely terminated long-run missions. Global saturation authority is reserved exclusively for CompletionGovernor and disabled during active Windows capacity.
enforcement: Worker may only return WORK_UNIT_COMPLETE or NO_MORE_WORK_KNOWN_TO_THIS_WORKER.

title: Automatic Low-Water Mark Replenishment of Research Frontier
rationale: Do not wait for ready queue to reach 0. When ready work drops below low-water mark (5 items), trigger WorkGenerator and replenish from ResearchReservoir.

title: Execution Uncertainty Blocks Auto-Redispatch
rationale: If dispatch may have occurred and side effects cannot be proven absent, state is EXECUTION_UNCERTAIN. Blind retry is forbidden to prevent duplicate external actions.
enforcement: ExecutionUncertaintyManager fences task until clean reconciliation.

title: Strict €0.00 Autonomous Spend Ceiling
rationale: Autonomous runtime must never incur real cloud or financial liability without human 2FA / hardware gate sign-off.

title: Result Customs Requires Verifiable Artifacts and Checksums
rationale: Worker prose is not proof. Result Customs rejects empty manifests, missing checksums, and non-zero exits.
